CYCLING COACH CANADA

Train with Italian Head Coach Matteo Cigala — from anywhere in Canada.

Matteo brings over 28 years of cycling experience, more than a decade of coaching riders around the world, and hundreds of race victories. He provides personalised coaching for road cycling, gravel, MTB, gran fondos and endurance riders, with every training plan built around your goals, your schedule and your lifestyle.

Whether you're in British Columbia, Alberta, Ontario, Quebec or anywhere else in Canada, training for a gran fondo, preparing for a gravel race, competing in local or Cycling Canada events, or working towards your next big cycling goal, your coaching is fully tailored to help you perform at your best.

BOOK FREE CONSULTATION

Why Canadian Cyclists Choose Cigala Cycling Coaching

  • Personalised daily/weekly training plans built around Critical Power (CP) and W′ modelling — going beyond basic FTP training
  • Powered by Vekta, a next-generation training platform used by WorldTour teams (membership worth €19.99/month included free)
  • Training Peaks also available if you're already set up there
  • Adaptive training zones that update as your fitness changes
  • Full support for sportives, Gran Fondos, time trials, road racing and general performance goals
  • Syncs with Garmin, Wahoo, Zwift and more
  • Nutritional guidance and access to a sports nutritionist and mental coach
  • Daily session carb reccomendations
  • Communication designed around Canada time zones — daily/weekly contact regardless of your coast
  

#TrainSmarterRideFaster

It's our vision

"Matteo's attention to detail is exceptional. Every part of the coaching is tailored to you, and it shows in the results. ★★★★★Chris - Ontario, Canada "The most exciting part of working with Matteo is the noticeable improvements I started to experience after just 4-6 weeks.
Since then, these improvements have been consistent and remarkable" ★★★★★Greg - Colorado, USA "Matteo schedules sessions that are built around your available time and utilizes quality over quantity. I have seen improvement year on year while working with Matteo." ★★★★★Mark - Alberta, Canada "Matteo has maximised every hour I can dedicate to training, making every session count." ★★★★★John - Quebec, Canda "You don't need to be an elite cyclist to benefit from Matteo's coaching. I can highly recommend him to anyone looking to get fitter and achieve their cycling goals, whatever their age or experience." ★★★★★Peter - British Columbia, Canda

Events We Help Canadian Riders Prepare For

Training toward a specific date changes everything about how a plan should be built. We coach riders preparing for Gran Fondos and races across the Canadian calendar, including:

  • RBC GranFondo Whistler (Vancouver to Whistler, BC)

  • Gran Fondo Axel Merckx Okanagan (Kelowna, BC)

  • Gran Fondo Baie Sainte-Marie (Nova Scotia)

  • Gran Fondo PEI (Prince Edward Island)

  • Revelstoke Gran Fondo (BC)

  • Ride to Conquer Cancer events (multiple provinces)

  • Cycling BC, Ontario and provincial road race/criterium calendars

Targeting an event further afield — a European Gran Fondo or a US Gran Fondo World Series qualifier? We build Canadian athletes' training blocks around those goals too, including winter indoor periodisation ahead of the trip.

READ MORE TESTIMONIALS

Coaching Cyclists Across Canada

Matteo coaches riders remotely delivering in from coast to coast in Canda, including:

  • British Columbia — Vancouver, Whistler, Victoria, Kelowna/Okanagan

  • Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Barrie

  • Alberta — Calgary, Edmonton

  • Quebec — Montreal, Quebec City

  • Atlantic Canada — Nova Scotia, PEI, New Brunswick

Wherever you're based, coaching is delivered the same way: personalised plan, remote feedback, and testing built around your local terrain, climate and event calendar.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Which package is right for me?

It depends on your budget and how much direct feedback you want. If you’re happy following a plan independently, Basic is enough. Advanced is our most popular package because it includes weekly access to Matteo plus Vekta membership.

I'm based in Canada — does coaching work remotely? How you handle winter training?

All coaching is delivered online — plans, feedback, testing and communication happen asynchronously via Vekta or Training Peaks, with calls scheduled to suit your time zone, whether you’re on the East Coast, West Coast, or anywhere between.

 

Your plan includes a dedicated gym & winter programme, built for indoor trainer work (Zwift, RGT, MyWhoosh, etc.) during the colder months, periodised so you come into spring with a real fitness base rather than starting over.

Do you only coach people who race?

No. We coach riders working toward weight loss, their first century ride, general fitness, Gran Fondos, triathlon or racing — the only requirement is that you ride a bike and want to improve.

Do I need to switch from Training Peaks to Vekta?

No — we can continue working in Training Peaks if you’re already comfortable there, or explore Vekta’s Critical Power and W′ analytics alongside it.

What age do I need to be?

We coach all ages, 14 and up — no upper limit. Riders under U23 receive a 20% student discount.

My event is months away — can I still sign up now?

Yes. Based on how far away is the event you can choose any suitable package.
